lines.zh: 我昂着头一颠一颠地走
lines.en: I strut along, head held high.

lines.zh: 琥珀色的羽毛在太阳下发亮
lines.en: My amber feathers shine in the sun.
I trot in short steps, as if in a hurry.
My claws scratch the ground twice.

lines.zh: 琥珀色的羽毛在太阳下发亮。
lines.en: My amber feathers shine in the sun.
My flock trails behind me.
I go around a patch of wet mud.
My wings are tucked in tight.
My tail bobs as I go.
I cross the dry straw.
There may be bugs here; I move slowly.
I turn and keep pacing.

lines.zh: 阳光照在背上暖烘烘的
lines.en: The sun is warm on my back.
I reach the wall and turn back.
Light steps, quick rhythm.

lines.zh: 我侧头看一眼,再往前走
lines.en: I glance sideways and walk on.
I tilt my head and hold still.
I ruffle my feathers.
I scratch out a hollow in the dust.
I squat with my wings against my sides.
The sun feels good on me.
I stretch my neck and call once.

lines.zh: 我用嘴理了理胸前的毛
lines.en: I preen the feathers on my chest.
A bug is crawling by the wall.
I blink one round eye.
Something is sounding far off.
I lift one foot.

lines.zh: 窝边那块土被我刨松了
lines.en: I have loosened the soil by the nest.

lines.zh: 我缩成一个琥珀色的团
lines.en: I tuck into an amber ball.

lines.zh: 风吹过来,羽毛翻了一下
lines.en: The wind lifts one feather.
I stay still and look first.
This is familiar ground.
I tilt my head at you.
Is there something in your hand?
I take two steps toward you.

lines.zh: 我这身琥珀色，从另一个世界带来。
lines.en: This amber coat came from another world.

lines.zh: 我眨着眼,一动不动地看
lines.en: I blink and stare without moving.
There is mud on your boots.

lines.zh: 我叫了一声,算是打招呼
lines.en: I call once, as a greeting.
I walk half a circle around you.
Do you like my feathers?
I lower my head, then raise it.
Crouch down and I will not be afraid.

lines.zh: 我退开半步,又靠近一点
lines.en: I step back, then come a little closer.
I let out a startled cry.
A few feathers came loose.
I hop a long way in one leap.
My wing will not lift properly.
I cluck in a panic.
It hurts, this really hurts.
I shrink into a round ball.
I run two steps and stop.
My amber feathers keep shivering.
Do not give me another one.
Are those seeds?
I come running at once.
I circle your feet.
Hurry, give it to me.
I peck at the ground.

lines.zh: 是种子，我一眼就认出来。
lines.en: Seeds. I know them at a glance.
I stretch my neck in close.
Not even one bite for me.

lines.zh: 我跟着你走两步，看你手里有没有种子。
lines.en: I will follow you two steps; any seeds in your hand?
I look up, waiting for you to scatter it.
I spread my wings a little.
Where you go, I follow.
I peck quickly and urgently.
Easier than digging in the dirt.
I cluck twice.
Do not stop; keep scattering.

lines.zh: 我的琥珀色尾羽被你踩了。
lines.en: You stepped on my amber tail feathers.
I am bumped and hop aside.
I flap to steady myself.
I am small; do not crowd me.
I cluck and back away.
All my feathers are mussed.
I walk around your feet.
The bump spins me around.
My wing slaps your calf.
Bring your eyes next time.
I fluff my feathers for you to see.
I pace a small circle around you.
I cluck softly.
The straw in the nest is soft.
You take that side; I take this one.
I lean my head gently against you.
We squat together in the sun.
I preen the feathers on your neck.
This yard is enough for us.
Let us stay quiet a while.
I peck it up and look at it.
Is this not edible?
I grab it and run off.
I drop it in the nest.
Shiny; I like it.
I shake my head to be rid of it.
I cannot drag this.
It feels rough in my beak.
I will bring it back to the flock.
I clamp down and will not let go.
There was a sound over there.
I stop and stare.
My neck is stretched straight.
I do not like this.
I edge toward the nest.
My flock is calling too.
My wings are half open.
Come closer and I will run.
My eyes have not left you.
This is not someone bringing food.

lines.zh: 我把脖子伸长，盯着你的手。
lines.en: Neck out, I stare at your hands.
I move only when you step back.
I shift my feet twice.
I slide along the base of the wall.
Do not reach down from above.
I am ready to run.
There is something in the nest to watch.
I cluck a warning.
Closer, and I will flap.
My escape route is that way.
I peck you on the hand.
I fly at you, wings beating.
My claws rake once.
That is all the force I have, sorry.

lines.zh: 琥珀色的羽毛，比石头还硬。
lines.en: Amber feathers, harder than stone.
I guard the nest and will not move.
I peck once and fall back.
My feathers are standing up.
Do not touch my flock.
I am not joking.
I pop out of the straw.

lines.zh: 琥珀色的羽毛先露出来
lines.en: My amber feathers show first.
I shake the straw off.
I tilt my head at this new place.
One clear call.
I take two steps and stop.
The soil here is loose.
I look up for the sun.
The rest of the flock is still behind.
I scratch the ground twice first.
My feathers smell scorched.
I drop out of the air.
Water up my nose; I flail.

lines.zh: 琥珀色的羽毛炸了一地。
lines.en: Amber feathers burst across the ground.
Something pierces my wing.
That force makes me dizzy.
Hunger keeps me from standing straight.
Lightning strikes; my whole body jolts.
There is no ground to stand on.
